place.name: Academy Museum of Motion Pictures
place.description: The Academy Museum of Motion Pictures is a film museum that opened in 2021 located in Los Angeles, California, United States, on Miracle Mile. The first large-scale museum of its kind in the United States, it houses part of the Academy Collection, the largest film-related collection in the world, with more than 52 million objects from notable films, and is dedicated to the arts, history, science, and artists of moviemaking and the film industry.
